name: The Times Square EDITION
positioning: Modern urban hotel in New York's Times Square (official name The Times Square EDITION), with Chef John Fraser's brasserie, a cabaret-style entertainment venue and a 24-hour gym
best_for: Travelers who want a Times Square base with views over the area
Guests who want dining and cabaret-style shows in the same hotel

facts.text: Guest rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows with views of Times Square and New York City.
Connecting rooms can add a second and third bedroom to a suite.
The Terrace and Outdoor Gardens is Chef John Fraser's modern brasserie with a seasonal menu that emphasizes locally sourced ingredients.
The Terrace and Outdoor Gardens offers many vegetable-forward dishes alongside brasserie classics.
Paradise Club has nightlife programming every Friday and Saturday.
The Lobby Bar serves coffee, cocktails and light bites daily.
Use of the 24-hour fitness facilities is complimentary.
High-speed wireless internet is complimentary throughout the hotel.
The hotel has built-in junket floors for press junkets and for television and movie filming.
Rockefeller Center is described by the hotel as steps away.
From the 50th Street subway station on 8th Avenue, the walk to the hotel is five minutes.

highlights.text: Paradise Club is the hotel's entertainment venue, with ticketed cabaret-style dinner shows and immersive theater.
The gym is open 24 hours and has an outdoor wraparound wellness deck with views of Times Square and midtown.
Corner suites have sofas, deep soaking tubs and furnished balconies.
The Lobby Bar has custom bleached leather armchairs and ivory hand-tufted silk area rugs.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the high-energy Times Square setting may not suit guests seeking tranquility.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning and prime location.
